stem_book: A smooth wire is bent into a vertical circle of radius a. A bead P can slide smoothly on the wire. The circle is rotated about diameter AB as axis with a speed ω as shown in the figure. The bead P is at rest with respect to the circular ring in the position shown (P at a distance a/2 from the axis). Then ω is equal to: (a) (2g/a)^(1/2) (b) [2g/(√3a)]^(1/2) (c) (√3g/a)^(1/2) (d) (g/2a)^(1/2)
work: a sinθ = a/2 ⇒ cosθ = √3/2; N sinθ = mω²a sinθ, N cosθ = mg ⇒ ω² = g/(a cosθ) = 2g/(√3a)
